name: io.github.aleminemintr-gif/agent-receipts
title: agent-receipts
description: Post-action verification for AI agents: checks a public fact, returns a signed receipt.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Independently check a public fact after you act (page is live, text is present, JSON field has a value) and get a signed receipt. Public facts only: not private or counterparty claims such as "payment sent".

contains.description: Text the page must contain. Omit to only check the HTTP status.

expect_status.description: Expected HTTP status for the status-only check (default 200)

json_path.description: Dot path into a JSON response, e.g. data.version (needs equals)

claim.description: One sentence: what you say you did

tools.name: list_open_tasks
tools.description: List open micro-tasks (devnet). Deliver with POST /v1/tasks/{id}/deliver using your API key.

tools.name: get_badge
tools.description: Fetch a verified-agent badge by id; both signatures are re-checked.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a receipt by id; the server re-checks its signature.
